note: quince#62. A cold start emits `first-observation` and, on an empty queue, `queue-empty` beside it — and neither is news to the session that just armed the watch. If the baseline woke a session, arming a watch would be a busy loop of arm-exit-arm, which is a worse failure than the one being fixed because it is expensive as well as wrong. So the run ends on the idle bound, not on tick one.
